mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals stronger consumer demand and economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a weakening economy, leading to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure that typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1800 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates and declining unemployment signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer credit demand (RSAFS above $350 billion), businesses expand investment and hiring, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 350000.
